text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Define zero denominator across all compared reviewers**

When the external reviews are clean but a sweep-enabled or sweep-off Ronda review has an adjudicated true-positive finding, this sentence incorrectly treats the denominator as zero and suppresses valid recall and variance results. Fresh evidence after the prior clean-review fix is the current AC15(d) rule, which explicitly includes confirmed defects found by any compared reviewer; zero therefore requires no confirmed defect from any compared reviewer, not merely clean external reviews.
